facts.business: SBFC Finance Limited is a secured MSME lender providing loans of ₹5 lakh to ₹30 lakh to self-employed small business owners, secured against residential or commercial property.

guidance_or_targets.statement: Journey from an AUM of ₹10,000 Cr to ₹20,000 Cr

key_risks: Fraud involving pledged gold (₹40.96 million pledged, ₹37.91 million claimed)
Credit risk in secured lending to self-employed segment
facts.related_party_note: Nominee directors from promoter holding company SBFC Holdings Pte. Ltd.
